limits: Local CPU wall timings include Python/validation/output-copy overhead, not model loading or snapshot setup. Teacher forcing is not sampled generation. Timings are descriptive, never a speed gate. Every sliding-window step rebuilds; no shortened-context tradeoff. KV payload excludes weights, token IDs, temporaries, allocator/Python/BLAS memory and process RSS. Counters are matrix shapes, not FLOPs. Float32 logit closeness does not guarantee identical sampling at every RNG threshold.
